papers.title: From Frames to Events: Rethinking Evaluation in Human-Centric Video Anomaly Detection
papers.authors: Narges Rashvand, Shanle Yao, Armin Danesh Pazho, Babak Rahimi Ardabili, Hamed Tabkhi
papers.tags: video segmentation, pose estimation, vision transformer, video search
papers.affiliations: University of North Carolina at Charlotte
papers.intro: 该论文主张将视频异常检测的评估范式从帧级转向事件级，通过基准事件结构审计、分数细化pipeline和端到端双分支模型，并首次引入基于tIoU的事件级评估标准，揭示了现有模型在真实事件定位能力上的巨大缺口。

papers.title: Harnessing Weak Pair Uncertainty for Text-based Person Search
papers.authors: Jintao Sun, Zhedong Zheng, Gangyi Ding
papers.tags: video search
papers.affiliations: 北京理工大学计算机科学与技术学院（Jintao Sun, Gangyi Ding）；澳门大学科学与技术学院（Zhedong Zheng）
papers.intro: 本文提出一种基于弱正样本对不确定性估计与正则化的学习方法，通过显式量化图像-文本弱正样本对的匹配不确定性，并设计组级匹配损失，使模型在训练中有效利用而非丢弃弱正样本对，从而显著提升文本描述行人检索的精度。

papers.title: UniversalVTG: A Universal and Lightweight Foundation Model for Video Temporal Grounding
papers.authors: Joungbin An, Agrim Jain, Kristen Grauman
papers.tags: video search, video segmentation, multimodal learning
papers.affiliations: The University of Texas at Austin
papers.intro: UniversalVTG通过引入离线查询统一器（Query Unifier）将异构查询格式规范化到共享语义空间，结合高效视觉骨干和轻量级定位头，在超过100万查询-片段对上大规模跨数据集预训练，实现了一个比MLLM方法小两个数量级但性能相当或更优的通用轻量级视频时间定位基础模型。

papers.title: Bridging Time and Space: Decoupled Spatio-Temporal Alignment for Video Grounding
papers.authors: Xuezhen Tu, Jingyu Wu, Fangyu Kang, Qingpeng Nong, Kaijin Zhang, Chaoyue Niu, Fan Wu
papers.tags: visual grounding, multimodal learning, video segmentation, tracking, video search
papers.affiliations: Shanghai Jiao Tong University; ZTE Corporation
papers.intro: 本文提出Bridge-STG，一种端到端的解耦式时空视频定位框架，通过时空语义桥接机制（STSB）和查询引导空间定位模块（QGSL）分别解决时空对齐纠缠和双域视觉token冗余问题，在VidSTG基准上将平均mvIoU从26.4提升至34.3，达到MLLM-based方法的最优性能。

papers.title: Preference Redirection via Attention Concentration: An Attack on Computer Use Agents
papers.authors: Dominik Seip, Matthias Hein
papers.tags: gui
papers.affiliations: Tübingen AI Center, University of Tübingen
papers.intro: 提出PRAC攻击，通过优化一个不可觉察的对抗补丁，集中CUA在视觉注意力上的分布，使其在电商网页上自动选择攻击者指定的目标产品。

papers.title: ESOM: Efficiently Understanding Streaming Video Anomalies with Open-world Dynamic Definitions
papers.authors: Zihao Liu, Xiaoyu Wu, Wenna Li, Jianqin Wu, Linlin Yang
papers.tags: video search
papers.affiliations: State Key Laboratory of Media Convergence and Communication, Communication University of China, Beijing, China
papers.intro: ESOM提出一个无需训练的流式开放世界视频异常检测框架，通过定义归一化、视觉token压缩、混合流式记忆和概率评分模块，在动态异常定义下实现单GPU实时推理，并在时序定位、分类和描述生成上达到SOTA性能，同时构建了更自然的OpenDef-Bench基准。

papers.title: Gym-Anything: Turn any Software into an Agent Environment
papers.authors: Pranjal Aggarwal, Graham Neubig, Sean Welleck
papers.tags: gui
papers.affiliations: Carnegie Mellon University (CMU)
papers.intro: 本文提出 Gym-Anything，一个将任意软件转化为交互式计算机使用环境的自动化框架，并通过多智能体创建-审计循环和GDP驱动的软件选择，构建了包含200个软件、超10,000个长视界任务的CUA-World基准。

papers.title: Pretrain-then-Adapt: Uncertainty-Aware Test-Time Adaptation for Text-based Person Search
papers.authors: Jiahao Zhang, Shaofei Huang, Yaxiong Wang, Zhedong Zheng
papers.tags: video search
papers.affiliations: University of Macau; Hefei University of Technology
papers.intro: 本文提出一种“预训练-自适应”（Pretrain-then-Adapt）范式及其核心框架UATTA，通过双向检索不一致性估计不确定性并重新加权熵最小化目标，仅使用无标注测试数据即可高效缓解文本行人检索中的域偏移。

papers.title: IntentScore: Intent-Conditioned Action Evaluation for Computer-Use Agents
papers.authors: Rongqian Chen, Yu Li, Zeyu Fang, Sizhe Tang, Weidong Cao, Tian Lan
papers.tags: gui
papers.affiliations: George Washington University, Washington D.C., USA
papers.intro: 本文提出IntentScore，一种轻量级、规划感知的奖励模型，通过双重目标训练（对比对齐+边际排序）从398K多系统离线GUI交互步骤中学习动作质量评估，并作为重排器提升CUA任务成功率。

papers.title: VideoZeroBench: Probing the Limits of Video MLLMs with Spatio-Temporal Evidence Verification
papers.authors: Jiahao Meng, Tan Yue, Qi Xu, Haochen Wang, Zhongwei Ren, Weisong Liu, Yuhao Wang, Renrui Zhang, Yunhai Tong, Haodong Duan
papers.tags: multimodal learning, video segmentation, scene understanding, video search
papers.affiliations: PKU（北京大学）、WHU（武汉大学）、CASIA（中国科学院自动化研究所）、BJTU（北京交通大学）、CUHK（香港中文大学）
papers.intro: VideoZeroBench是一个面向长视频理解的分层基准，通过五级评估协议严格验证模型的时空证据定位能力，揭示当前视频MLLMs在标准QA下准确率不足17%、在严格时空定位要求下准确率低于1%的严重能力瓶颈。

papers.title: GUIDE: Resolving Domain Bias in GUI Agents through Real-Time Web Video Retrieval and Plug-and-Play Annotation
papers.authors: Rui Xie, Zhi Gao, Chenrui Shi, Zirui Shang, Lu Chen, Qing Li
papers.tags: gui
papers.affiliations: Shanghai Jiao Tong University; State Key Laboratory for General Artificial Intelligence, BIGAI; Beijing Institute of Technology
papers.intro: GUIDE提出一种无需训练、即插即用的框架，通过实时从网络教程视频中检索并自动注释领域知识，以零样本方式解决GUI智能体的规划和定位两方面的领域偏见，在OSWorld基准上一致提升超过5%并减少执行步数。

papers.title: GridVAD: Open-Set Video Anomaly Detection via Spatial Reasoning over Stratified Frame Grids
papers.authors: Mohamed Eltahir, Ahmed O. Ibrahim, Obada Siralkhatim, Tabarak Abdallah, Sondos Mohamed
papers.tags: object detection, video segmentation, instance segmentation, video search
papers.affiliations: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST), Thuwal, Saudi Arabia; Independent Researcher; National Center for Research (NCR), Khartoum, Sudan
papers.intro: GridVAD提出了一种无需训练的“提议-接地-传播”（propose-ground-propagate）流水线，利用VLM生成开放集异常文本提议、自一致合并（SCC）过滤幻觉、Grounding DINO和SAM2完成像素级空间定位与时序传播，在不进行任何领域特定训练的情况下实现像素级视频异常掩码…

papers.title: EagleNet: Energy-Aware Fine-Grained Relationship Learning Network for Text-Video Retrieval
papers.authors: Yuhan Chen, Pengwen Dai, Chuan Wang, Dayan Wu, Xiaochun Cao
papers.tags: multimodal learning, CLIP, video segmentation, video search
papers.affiliations: Sun Yat-sen University; Shenzhen Campus of Sun Yat-sen University; Shenzhen Key Laboratory of Adversarial Artificial Intelligence; Beijing Jiaotong University; Institute of Information Engineering, CAS
papers.intro: EagleNet通过构建文本-帧关系图并引入能量感知匹配机制，在扩展文本语义时同时建模文本-帧交互和帧间关系，生成上下文感知的富文本嵌入，从而提升文本-视频检索的精度。

papers.title: Unbiased Multimodal Reranking for Long-Tail Short-Video Search
papers.authors: Wenyi Xu, Feiran Zhu, Songyang Li, Renzhe Zhou, Chao Zhang, Chenglei Dai, Yuren Mao, Yunjun Gao, Yi Zhang
papers.tags: multimodal learning, video search, diffusion model, CLIP
papers.affiliations: 浙江大学、快手科技
papers.intro: 本文提出一个由LLM驱动的多模态重排序框架，通过两阶段训练（监督微调+成对偏好优化）学习用户行为无关的体验评分，并将其注入生产级重排序流水线以缓解长尾短视频搜索中的多种偏差。

papers.title: CUA-Suite: Massive Human-annotated Video Demonstrations for Computer-Use Agents
papers.authors: Xiangru Jian, Shravan Nayak, Kevin Qinghong Lin, Aarash Feizi, Kaixin Li, Patrice Bechard, Spandana Gella, Sai Rajeswar
papers.tags: gui
papers.affiliations: ServiceNow, University of Waterloo, Mila, Université de Montréal, McGill University, University of Oxford, National University of Singapore
papers.intro: 本文提出CUA-Suite，一个包含约55小时、600万帧连续高清人类演示视频（VideoCUA）、56K张密集标注截图（GroundCUA）和严格接地/规划评估基准（UI-Vision）的大规模桌面计算机使用代理数据集生态系统，全面支持训练与评估。

papers.title: Cross-modal Fuzzy Alignment Network for Text-Aerial Person Retrieval and A Large-scale Benchmark
papers.authors: Yifei Deng, Chenglong Li, Yuyang Zhang, Guyue Hu, Jin Tang
papers.tags: multimodal learning, CLIP, image retrieval, video search
papers.affiliations: Yifei Deng - 安徽大学（State Key Laboratory of Opto-Electronic Information Acquisition and Protection Technology；School of Computer Science and Technology, Anhui University） Chenglong Li - 安徽大学（State Key Laboratory of Opto-Electronic Information Acquisition and Protection Technology） Yuyang Zhang - The U
papers.intro: 本文提出一种跨模态模糊对齐网络（CFAN），通过模糊逻辑量化令牌级可靠性和利用地面视角图像作为桥接代理，有效缓解航拍图像与文本描述之间的语义鸿沟，并构建了大规模航拍人物检索基准AERI-PEDES。

papers.title: CoVR-R:Reason-Aware Composed Video Retrieval
papers.authors: Omkar Thawakar, Dmitry Demidov, Vaishnav Potlapalli, Sai Prasanna Teja Reddy Bogireddy, Viswanatha Reddy Gajjala, Alaa Mostafa Lasheen, Rao Muhammad Anwer, Fahad Khan
papers.tags: video search, multimodal learning, video segmentation
papers.affiliations: Mohamed bin Zayed University of AI, University of Chicago, University of Wisconsin-Madison, Linköping University
papers.intro: 本文提出了一种推理优先的零样本组合视频检索方法CoVR-R，利用大型多模态模型（Qwen3-VL-8B）推断编辑隐含的因果和时间后效，并将其转化为效果感知查询来指导检索，同时构建了CoVR-Reason基准测试来评估推理能力，在无需任务特定微调的情况下显著优于强基线方法。

papers.title: Vision-Language Attribute Disentanglement and Reinforcement for Lifelong Person Re-Identification
papers.authors: Kunlun Xu, Haotong Cheng, Jiangmeng Li, Xu Zou, Jiahuan Zhou
papers.tags: multimodal learning, CLIP, image retrieval, video search
papers.affiliations: Wangxuan Institute of Computer Technology, Peking University; University of Chinese Academy of Sciences; School of Artificial Intelligence and Automation, Huazhong University of Science and Technology
papers.intro: 论文提出VLADR框架，通过多粒度文本属性解耦（MTAD）与跨域跨模态属性强化（ICAR），显式建模和传递人类共享属性，从而在终身行人重识别中同时提升跨域知识获取与抗遗忘能力。

papers.title: Zoom to Essence: Trainless GUI Grounding by Inferring upon Interface Elements
papers.authors: Ziwei Liu, Tao Feng, Borui Kang, Yanbing Yang, Jun Luo
papers.tags: visual grounding, object detection, multimodal learning, gui
papers.affiliations: Sichuan University, Tsinghua University, Nanjing University, Nanyang Technological University
papers.intro: ZoomUI是一种无需训练（trainless）的GUI grounding方法，通过推理缩放（inference scaling）将模糊指令转化为目标元素的视觉特征描述，并利用模型内部注意力迭代放大目标区域，在多个基准上达到甚至超越现有SOTA方法。

papers.title: SPARROW: Learning Spatial Precision and Temporal Referential Consistency in Pixel-Grounded Video MLLMs
papers.authors: Mohamad Alansari, Naufal Suryanto, Divya Velayudhan, Sajid Javed, Naoufel Werghi, Muzammal Naseer
papers.tags: video segmentation, tracking, multimodal learning, visual grounding, video search
papers.affiliations: Khalifa University, Abu Dhabi, UAE
papers.intro: SPARROW通过引入目标特定跟踪特征（TSF）和双提示（BOX+SEG）接地机制，统一了像素级视频MLLMs的空间精度与时间稳定性，在不依赖外部检测器的情况下实现了端到端的指代一致视频分割。
